name: Privacy Route
author: Design Nexus
description: NordVPN and Tor behind one icon, with only one of them carrying system traffic at a time. Combines io.github.guiestrela.nordvpn and tripleu.tor.

barWidget.description: Switch between direct, NordVPN and Tor. Starting one route takes the other down first. Right click toggles the last route, middle click refreshes.

schema.label: Route for right click
schema.description: Updated automatically to the last route used. Per-route settings live in the nested nord and tor objects of this widget's shell.json entry.
